title: Vwoom Vwoom!
description: New block that makes you supa fast!
body:
Goofy mod I made that adds a new block, the Block of Vwoom! You find Vwoom Ore from height 0 to 64. Craft 4 Vwoom Gems which you get from mining the Vwoom Ore to make a Block of Vwoom! The Block of Vwoom allows you to go super fast on it. BTW this is really broken don't use this in a world that you don't want to break because you can go so fast you get stuck in unloaded chunks for a few minutes.





I'd appreciate it if you downloaded this mod because it's my first public mod!

I have a YT channel! (I'm trying to start to make vids again! And a showcase of this mod is coming soon!): https://www.youtube.com/@Maximusslide

I will not make versions for any other game version or mod loader. This was just a project made for fun.
